title: JANUS Linear A SigLA source-native word-class structural bijection audit specification

audit_population.selection_rule: Use exactly the 19 documents from the frozen parent result whose structural_family is WORD_CLASS_SPAN_AND_ANCHOR; no resampling and no replacement.

predeclared_nodes.popup_word: descendant of the unique document-view container with tag span and class tokens popup + word
predeclared_nodes.svg_word_anchor: descendant of an svg under the unique document-view container with tag a and class token word

predeclared_tests_per_document.popup_id_uniqueness: all non-empty popup span id attributes are unique
predeclared_tests_per_document.svg_fragment_uniqueness: all non-empty svg word-anchor href fragment targets are unique
predeclared_tests_per_document.exact_fragment_reference_bijection: every popup word has a non-empty unique id, every svg word anchor has a non-empty href beginning with #, and the set of href fragments after removing only the leading # exactly equals the set of popup ids
predeclared_tests_per_document.no_normalization: No URL decoding, case folding, punctuation rewriting or semantic equivalence is allowed for reference matching.

forbidden: do not infer left↔even or right↔odd correspondence
do not extract or compare literal transcription payload
do not fetch live SigLA pages
do not repair missing ids or hrefs
do not treat source-native class word as independent linguistic validation
do not freeze a content payload grammar from count parity alone
success_gate: The immutable parent artifact validates, exactly the frozen 19 capability-positive snapshots are audited, no live fetch occurs, and count/reference results are persisted without semantic interpretation.
next_if_exact_bijection_is_universal: Freeze the DOM reference edge as a source-native structural unit relation, then separately probe the popup descendant payload schema before extracting transcription content.
next_if_not_universal: Retain capability inventory but do not freeze a universal word-unit relation; predeclare structural subfamilies or a larger validation gate without posthoc repair.
